metadata.title: chore(tests): fix slow tests by mocking unmocked network calls
metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
## Summary

- Move non-deterministic performance benchmark test to `tests/fuzz/`
- Fix 6 unit tests that were 5-60x slower than necessary due to unmocked network calls, wrong mock targets, or hardcoded sleeps:
  - **content moderation** (60s to <1s): mock primary/fallback HTTP providers to avoid real timeout cascade
  - **OAuth health check** (10s to <1s): mock `get_isolated_http_client` instead of unused `_http_client`
  - **OAuth init failure** (5s to <1s): mock `_connect_to_sse_server_without_validation` (the method actually called) instead of `connect_to_sse_server`
  - **gateway activation** (5s to <1s): mock `_initialize_gateway` and `_publish_event` to skip real HTTP connects
  - **gateway mode update** (5s to <1s): same `_initialize_gateway`/`_publish_event` mocking
  - **UDS fixture** (5.4s to 0.5s): replace `time.sleep(5)` with UDS connection readiness poll
- CI and Makefile tweaks: `pytest -n auto`, `--durations=5`, coverage target refactoring

## Test plan
- [x] `make test` passes (12,965 passed, 455 skipped)
- [x] All 6 previously slow tests verified fast individually

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body:
This test no longer verifies that the refreshed OAuth tokens are actually used in the outgoing health-check request. Since the SSE health check path calls `client.stream(..., headers={Authorization: Bearer ...})`, consider asserting the `mock_client.stream` call args include `Bearer token1` on the first call and `Bearer token2` on the second call (in addition to `get_access_token` call count).
```suggestion

        # Verify the HTTP client was called twice (once per health check)
        assert mock_client.stream.call_count == 2

        # Verify that the correct OAuth tokens were used in the Authorization header
        first_call_args = mock_client.stream.call_args_list[0]
        second_call_args = mock_client.stream.call_args_list[1]

        first_headers = first_call_args[1].get("headers") or {}
        second_headers = second_call_args[1].get("headers") or {}

        assert first_headers.get("Authorization") == "Bearer token1"
        assert second_headers.get("Authorization") == "Bearer token2"
```

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body:
The `coverage-pytest` help text says it runs "doctests + unit tests", but the command only runs `tests/` (and explicitly ignores fuzz/manual/e2e), while doctests run under the separate `coverage` target. Update the help text to match the actual behavior, or add doctest collection to `coverage-pytest` if that’s the intent.
```suggestion
# help: coverage-pytest      - Run pytest unit tests with coverage collection
```

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body: Removing `pre-commit` from the `LINTERS` list changes what `make lint-all` runs (it will no longer execute the pre-commit hooks). If this is intentional, it should be called out in the PR description (or consider keeping it in `LINTERS` to avoid silently reducing lint coverage).

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body: This test now mocks `_initialize_gateway`, but the docstring says `only_update_reachable` “skips full re-initialization”. In `GatewayService.set_gateway_state`, transitioning from unreachable→reachable still calls `_initialize_gateway` before the `only_update_reachable` branch is applied. Consider either asserting `_initialize_gateway` was awaited (to document the current behavior) or updating the test description/name to avoid a misleading claim.

comments.author: jonpspri
comments.body: Good catch — restored the token assertions on `mock_client.stream` call args to verify `Bearer token1` and `Bearer token2` are used in the outgoing requests. Fixed in 7f72d94.

comments.author: jonpspri
comments.body: Fixed — updated the help text to say "Run pytest unit tests with coverage collection". Fixed in 7f72d94.

comments.author: jonpspri
comments.body: Intentional removal — `pre-commit` runs its own superset of checks that overlap with the individual linters, and we prefer to run it separately (e.g. as a git hook) rather than as part of `make lint-all`.

comments.author: jonpspri
comments.body: Good point — updated the docstring to clarify that `only_update_reachable` skips tool/resource/prompt bulk updates but not gateway initialization, and added `gateway_service._initialize_gateway.assert_awaited_once()` to document the actual behavior. Fixed in 7f72d94.

reviews.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer[bot]
reviews.body:
## Pull request overview This PR targets test-suite performance and determinism by eliminating unintended real network waits in unit tests, relocating a non-deterministic benchmark-style test into the fuzz suite, and updating local/CI test runners to surface slow tests and parallelize appropriately. **Changes:** - Mock previously-unmocked network paths in several gateway/OAuth/content-moderation unit tests to avoid real HTTP/SSE timeouts. - Replace a hardcoded `sleep(5)` in a UDS subprocess fixture with a readiness probe (connect loop). - Update test/coverage invocations in the Makefile and GitHub Actions workflow (xdist `-n auto`, durations reporting, coverage target refactor). ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 7 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | tests/unit/mcpgateway/services/test_gateway_service_oauth_comprehensive.py | Fixes slow OAuth tests by mocking the actual health-check HTTP client and the correct SSE connect method. | | tests/unit/mcpgateway/services/test_gateway_service.py | Avoids slow gateway-mode/state tests by mocking gateway initialization/event publication. | | tests/unit/mcpgateway/plugins/plugins/content_moderation/test_content_moderation.py | Prevents real moderation-provider HTTP calls by mocking all provider fallbacks. | | tests/unit/mcpgateway/plugins/framework/external/mcp/test_client_streamable_http.py | Replaces a fixed sleep with a UDS accept/readiness probe to reduce flakiness and time. | | tests/fuzz/test_security_performance_compatibility.py | Updates file header path after moving the test into `tests/fuzz/`. | | Makefile | Parallelizes pytest with `-n auto`, adds durations, refactors coverage targets, tweaks lint target list and tomllint excludes. | | .github/workflows/pytest.yml | Runs pytest/doctests with xdist `-n auto` and ignores an e2e test in the main unit run. |

commits.message:
chore(tests): fix slow tests by mocking unmocked network calls

- Move non-deterministic performance test to tests/fuzz/
- Fix content moderation test (60s→<1s): mock primary/fallback providers
  to avoid real HTTP timeouts through the fallback chain
- Fix OAuth health check test (10s→<1s): mock get_isolated_http_client
  instead of unused service._http_client
- Fix OAuth initialization failure test (5s→<1s): mock correct method
  (_connect_to_sse_server_without_validation vs connect_to_sse_server)
- Fix gateway activation test (5s→<1s): mock _initialize_gateway and
  _publish_event to avoid real HTTP connect timeouts
- Fix gateway mode update test (5s→<1s): same _initialize_gateway and
  _publish_event mocking
- Fix UDS fixture (5.4s→0.5s): replace time.sleep(5) with connection
  readiness poll on the unix domain socket

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
